featured_reviews.review_text:
Pathetic Experience - Never Again
This was the worst customer experience I've ever had. I ordered Hush Puppies slippers, but they failed on every promise:
• They promised 2-day delivery but did not deliver on time.
• The size I wanted was not in stock.
• They charged me an extra ₹800, despite the same item being available on Myntra at a discounted price.
• They provided the porter with the wrong address.
• They left the porter waiting for 20 minutes without paying him.
• I sent an email to cancel the order, but they never responded.
This was a pathetic experience, and I would not recommend this store to anyone.

featured_reviews.review_text:
*Please train your staff to be honest, open, and forthcoming with the information on offers and such*.

This review is specific to our visit to the Mochi outlet at Sky City Mall on 15.12.25.

We were there to shop for sandals.  We were attended by Mohd Aaman Salauddin Ansari.  Everything went well until the billing.  We asked the sales person if there was any ongoing discount. He said there wasn't, and after looking at the screen for a while, got up and brought us a small bottle of ZeOLite foot spray saying this will be free for you. There was some discrepancy in the billing amount and the MRP of the sandals I had bought. He couldn't clarify it.

Later when we checked the Mochi website we found out that there was 11% discount on the sandals.  Then we looked at the E-bill ( which takes a while to come) and realised what the salesperson had done!
Instead of telling us about the discount, he had made us force buy the product we didn't want or need.

I'd like to feel happy at the end of any shopping experience. Here I felt duped, which is not the kind of shopping experience we usually get in an outlet like Mochi.

Please train your staff to be honest, open, and forthcoming with the information on offers and such.   I would like to return the foot spray and get my money back.

In addition to men's, women's, and kids' footwear it also has a wide range of handbags, belts, wallets, etc.

featured_reviews.name: Arvind V
featured_reviews.review_text: Extremely disappointed with my recent purchases from Metro Shoes. Out of three pairs of shoes I bought, two turned out to be complete waste of money. The first pair had such poor quality that I had to return it within just 3 days. The second pair completely broke after only 68 days of normal wear. To make matters worse, the customer service and staff behavior at the store are absolutely terrible—unhelpful and rude. Save your hard-earned money and buy from somewhere else. The product quality and service here have gone downhill.

featured_reviews.name: Riddhi Thakkar
featured_reviews.review_text: My Abrar Khan was very kind, patient, polite and jolly while we went here to buy footwear. My mother is a senior citizen and has osterioporisis, so getting the right footwear in which she is comfortable is very difficult. Through out shopping Mr Abrar Khan helped us ,he did not hurry and calmly and patiently assisted.  Thank you!!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Riddhi Thakkar, we're happy to hear that you had an excellent shopping experience and found what you wanted. Your satisfaction is our top priority. We look forward to seeing you again at our store :)
